Yes, a bit more short of breath than my usual. It’s worse when I move around, and the wheezing is more noticeable when I exhale.

No, I haven’t noticed any swelling in my legs or ankles.

No, I haven’t seen any blood in the sputum.

They’ve been getting worse over the last few days. I can’t say the exact number, but it’s been recently—since the cough and colored sputum started getting more.

Yes, I’ve been using my rescue inhaler, and it helps some, but the wheezing and shortness of breath are still there. I’m also doing my usual breathing treatments when I can.
